title: TemporalSemanticAnnotation
description: Structured VLM semantic annotation for multi-frame action sequences (Milestone M5.4)

displacement.description: True if an object visibly translates across image coordinates (T1).

directional_motion.description: True if action identity depends on chronological arrow of time (T2).

state_transition.description: True if an object undergoes discrete physical state transition (T3).

object_interaction.description: True if actor makes physical contact or manipulates object (T4).

relative_motion.description: True if object moves relative to another object or camera frame (T5).

event_order.description: True if action consists of multi-step sequential sub-events (T6).

static_appearance.description: True if sequence contains minimal to zero visible motion (Negative Control T7).

frame_ambiguity.description: True if individual isolated frames are visually ambiguous without sequence (T8).

frame_criticality.description: 0-indexed frame numbers (out of 8) containing the most discriminative transition.

temporal_dependency.description: Degree to which chronological sequence is necessary to classify action.

observed_action_description.description: Concise 1-2 sentence description of the primary visual action observed.

confidence.description: Model self-reported confidence score in the annotation.
